parameters.query:
SELECT id, gmail_message_id, sender_name, sender_email, subject, category, urgency, summary, deadline, confidence_note, received_at, processed_at
FROM leads
WHERE needs_human_review = 1
  AND review_digest_sent_at IS NULL
  AND urgency IS DISTINCT FROM 'high'   -- urgent ones were already alerted immediately
ORDER BY processed_at;
